label: Which picture should this look use?
explain: The options are the reference pictures on this row, named A and B in their file names. Nothing is installed until you pick.

RM_LiquidTank_Industrial.why: judge KEEP on both; A is exactly what you asked (rust cleaned, else unchanged)
RM_LiquidTank_Industrial.context: A: the shipped tank with the rust painted over in gunmetal, a few rust weeps kept. B: the same drawing in sand-grey equipment paint (the Star Wars standard side of Industrial). New Industrial redraws with an analog dial wait for the image generator (Codex sign-in).

RM_LiquidTank_Modern.context: A: the shipped white leg tank weathered: UV yellowing, matte, dust from the feet, grime streaks, smudges. The judge kept it but found the change small at play zoom. Only option A exists: realistic redraws (other real tank types, an analog dial) wait for the image generator (Codex sign-in).

RM_UniversalPipe_Modern.context: A: touch-up patches of other paint (older darker blue, a greener batch, grey primer) on a duller, matte blue. B: sun-faded blue-grey with sparse red-oxide primer scuffs and bare-steel chips. Seams checked: 0 failures. The paint repeats once per cell (a link atlas cannot vary per cell).

RM_SprinklerHead_Modern.context: A and B match pipe A and pipe B. Either sits on either pipe.

RM_LiquidTank.why: the Scrapper tank is the look you accept
RM_LiquidTank.context: The Scrapper tank: the look you said reads right. Shown for comparison at the same true scale; nothing is asked here.
